decision.reason: [ev-5aa24b618332] bundles four separate additions into one item: an Alias field in EC2NodeClass.Spec.AMISelectorTerms, Disruption Budgets by Reason in NodePool.Spec.Disruption.Budgets, TerminationGracePeriod in NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec, and the LOG_OUTPUT_PATHS and LOG_ERROR_OUTPUT_PATHS environment variables. That means no single subject, change or consequence can be written for the item. The section context adds detail only for Alias: [ev-4bcafa8a355e] says it cannot be combined with other term types and must match the AMI Family, and [ev-f91dbd14d0cc] adds the unregistered taint behaviour. Nothing shown explains how budget reasons, TerminationGracePeriod or the log-path variables behave, or what happens if an operator does nothing. The item needs to be split into its four changes, and each one needs its own concrete evidence (for example, the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure that [ev-bfb089d90d84] refers to, which isn't shown).
